name: Ants
overview: Scripture uses the example of ants to teach diligence and wise preparation despite their small size and lack of strength, as seen in Proverbs 6:6 and Proverbs 30:25. The ant's industrious nature contrasts sharply with the sluggard, whose desires go unmet due to laziness (Proverbs 13:4, Proverbs 20:4). Believers are encouraged to serve with a willing heart as unto the Lord, reflecting the ant’s faithful work ethic (Ephesians 6:7). This teaches a Christ-centered ethic of responsible stewardship and wholehearted service.
